Meaning: Frugal means simple, plain, and costing little; sparing or economical with regard to money or food.
Synonym: Economical means avoiding waste and using resources carefully.
Other options: Extravagant and wasteful are antonyms, while generous means showing a readiness to give more than is necessary.
Vocab Meanings:
• Frugal: Careful in spending money (मितव्ययी / किफ़ायती)
• Extravagant: Spending too much money (फिज़ूलखर्च)
• Economical: Saving money; not wasteful (किफ़ायती)
• Generous: Willing to give (उदार)
• Wasteful: Using more than needed (बर्बादी करने वाला)

question.en:
In the sentence below, choose the option that is closest in meaning to ephemeral.
The artist was interested only in ephemeral beauty rather than permanence. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 26/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Meaning: Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time; fleeting or transient.
Synonym: Transitory means not permanent; of brief duration.
Other options: Enduring, lasting, and eternal are direct antonyms of ephemeral.
Vocab Meanings:
• Ephemeral: Lasting a very short time (क्षणभंगुर)
• Enduring: Lasting a long time (स्थायी / टिकाऊ)
• Lasting: Continuing for a long time (टिकाऊ)
• Transitory: Lasting only a short time (क्षणिक / अस्थायी)
• Eternal: Lasting for ever (शाश्वत)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
SUBSIDIARY [SSC Selection Post (10th) 16/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: 'Subsidiary' means less important than but related or supplementary to something else; secondary.
'Secondary' accurately captures this meaning.
Other options: 'Primary' and 'Main' are antonyms, while 'Integral' means essential or necessary.
Vocab Meanings:
• Subsidiary: Less important; supporting (सहायक / गौण)
• Secondary: Second in order or importance (द्वितीयक / गौण)
• Primary: First or most basic (प्राथमिक)
• Main: Chief; most important (मुख्य)
• Integral: Necessary to make something complete (अभिन्न / अनिवार्य)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
SYCOPHANT [SSC Selection Post (10th) 16/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: A 'sycophant' is a person who acts obsequiously toward someone important in order to gain advantage; a servile flatterer or bootlicker.
Other options: 'Leader' is a person who guides others, 'Teacher' is an educator, and 'Enemy' is a foe.
Vocab Meanings:
• Sycophant: A person who flatters powerful people to gain favour (चाटुकार / चापलूस)
• Leader: A person who leads or guides others (नेता)
• Bootlicker: A person who flatters others to please them (चापलूस / जी-हुज़ूरी करने वाला)
• Teacher: A person who teaches (शिक्षक)
• Enemy: A person who is hostile to another (शत्रु)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
CASUAL [SSC Selection Post (10th) 17/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Casual means relaxed, unconcerned, or not formal; hence, Informal is its exact synonym.
'Serious' and 'Planned' are antonyms of casual.
Vocab Meanings:
• Casual: Relaxed and informal; not planned (अनौपचारिक / आकस्मिक)
• Serious: Grave; not joking (गंभीर)
• Planned: Arranged in advance (नियोजित)
• Informal: Relaxed; not formal (अनौपचारिक)
• Heavy: Weighing a lot (भारी)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
SHELTERED [SSC Selection Post (10th) 17/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Sheltered means shielded from danger, bad weather, or difficulties; therefore, Protected is the closest synonym.
'Exposed' acts as an antonym.
Vocab Meanings:
• Sheltered: Protected from danger or difficulty (संरक्षित / आश्रय प्राप्त)
• Protected: Kept safe from harm (सुरक्षित)
• Hurt: Injured or upset (आहत)
• Sold: Given in exchange for money (बेचा हुआ)
• Exposed: Unprotected; open to harm (असुरक्षित / खुला)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
CONSENTED [SSC Selection Post (10th) 17/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Consented means gave permission or agreed to something; Assented means expressed approval or agreement, making it the correct synonym.
'Refused' and 'Denied' are antonyms.
Vocab Meanings:
• Consented: Agreed or gave permission (सहमति दी)
• Refused: Said no (मना किया)
• Scorned: Treated with contempt (तिरस्कार किया)
• Assented: Agreed to something (स्वीकृति दी / सहमत हुआ)
• Denied: Said something is not true or refused (इनकार किया)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
AFFLUENT [SSC Selection Post (10th) 18/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Affluent means having a great deal of money or wealth; prosperous. Therefore, Wealthy is the exact synonym. 'Poor' is an antonym, while 'Weak' and 'Angry' are unrelated in meaning.
Vocab Meanings:
• Affluent: Rich; wealthy (समृद्ध / धनी)
• Poor: Having little money (गरीब)
• Wealthy: Having lots of money (धनवान)
• Weak: Lacking strength (कमज़ोर)
• Angry: Feeling strong displeasure (क्रोधित)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
TIRADE [SSC Selection Post (10th) 18/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Tirade refers to a long, angry speech of criticism or accusation. Diatribe is a direct synonym meaning a forceful and bitter verbal attack. 'Approval', 'Praise', and 'Eulogy' are antonyms conveying positive commendation.
Vocab Meanings:
• Tirade: A long angry speech of criticism (तीखी आलोचना / लंबा कटु भाषण)
• Diatribe: A bitter verbal attack (कटु निंदा)
• Approval: Official agreement or good opinion (स्वीकृति)
• Praise: Words of admiration (प्रशंसा)
• Eulogy: A speech praising someone (स्तुति / गुणगान)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
FRAGILE [SSC Selection Post (10th) 19/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Fragile means easily broken or damaged.
Delicate is the most appropriate synonym as it also means easily damaged or fragile.
Other options: Strong is an antonym, while Bright and Heavy are unrelated in meaning.
Vocab Meanings:
• Fragile: Easily broken or damaged (नाज़ुक / भंगुर)
• Strong: Powerful; not easily broken (मज़बूत)
• Delicate: Soft and easily damaged (नाज़ुक / कोमल)
• Bright: Giving out a lot of light (चमकीला)
• Heavy: Weighing a lot (भारी)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
ADJUSTED [SSC Selection Post (10th) 19/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Adjusted means altered or moved slightly to achieve the desired fit, appearance, or result, or having become accustomed to a new condition.
Adapted is the closest synonym, meaning made suitable to a new use or condition.
Other options: Broke and Lost are irrelevant, and Unaccustomed is opposite in context.
Vocab Meanings:
• Adjusted: Changed slightly to fit; adapted (समायोजित / अनुकूलित)
• Adapted: Changed to suit new conditions (अनुकूल बना हुआ)
• Broke: Damaged; or having no money (टूटा / कंगाल)
• Lost: Unable to be found (खोया हुआ)
• Unaccustomed: Not used to something (अनभ्यस्त)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
STANCH [SSC Selection Post (10th) 19/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Stanch (or staunch) means to stop, check, or restrict the flow of something (often blood or flow of events), hence to extinguish or Suppress.
Other options: Start, Continue, and Persist are antonyms representing continuation or initiation.
Vocab Meanings:
• Stanch: To stop the flow of something (e.g. blood) (रोकना / बहाव बंद करना)
• Suppress: To stop or hold back by force (दबाना / रोकना)
• Start: To begin (शुरू करना)
• Continue: To keep going (जारी रखना)
• Persist: To continue firmly (डटे रहना)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
PASSIVE [SSC Selection Post (10th) 21/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: 'Passive' means accepting or allowing what happens or what others do without active response or resistance; inactive.
Therefore, Inactive is the correct synonym.
'Active' is an antonym, while 'Hungry' and 'Helpful' are unrelated.
Vocab Meanings:
• Passive: Accepting without active response (निष्क्रिय)
• Active: Busy and energetic (सक्रिय)
• Inactive: Not active (निष्क्रिय)
• Hungry: Wanting food (भूखा)
• Helpful: Giving help (सहायक)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
BAFFLEMENT [SSC Selection Post (10th) 21/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: 'Bafflement' means a state of being completely perplexed or bewildered.
Therefore, Bewilderment is the exact synonym.
'Confidence', 'Conviction', and 'Certainty' are antonyms denoting assurance and clarity.
Vocab Meanings:
• Bafflement: The state of being confused (घबराहट / उलझन)
• Confidence: Belief in oneself (आत्मविश्वास)
• Conviction: A firmly held belief (दृढ़ विश्वास)
• Certainty: The state of being sure (निश्चितता)
• Bewilderment: A feeling of great confusion (हैरानी / किंकर्तव्यविमूढ़ता)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
INDISTINCT [SSC Selection Post (10th) 22/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Indistinct means not clearly defined, visible, or audible; lacking sharp clarity.
Blurry means not clear or distinct, making it the closest synonym.
The other options ('Clear', 'Loud', 'New') do not convey this meaning.
Vocab Meanings:
• Indistinct: Not clear; blurred (अस्पष्ट)
• Clear: Easy to see or understand (स्पष्ट)
• Blurry: Unclear; out of focus (धुंधला)
• Loud: Producing a lot of noise (तेज़ आवाज़ वाला)
• New: Recently made (नया)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
HIDEOUS [SSC Selection Post (10th) 22/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Hideous means extremely ugly, offensive, or unpleasant.
Obnoxious means extremely unpleasant, offensive, or odious, serving as the most appropriate synonym among the given choices.
'Appealing' and 'Pleasant' are antonyms, while 'Innocuous' means harmless.
Vocab Meanings:
• Hideous: Extremely ugly or unpleasant (घिनौना / अत्यंत कुरूप)
• Innocuous: Harmless (हानिरहित)
• Appealing: Attractive; pleasing (आकर्षक)
• Obnoxious: Extremely unpleasant; offensive (घृणित / अप्रिय)
• Pleasant: Nice; enjoyable (सुखद)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
GLITTERING [SSC Selection Post (10th) 23/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Glittering means shining with a shimmering or sparkling light.
Gleaming also means shining brightly with reflected light, making it the closest synonym.
Other options: Lackluster and Darkened mean dull or lacking brightness; Quiet means making little or no noise.
Vocab Meanings:
• Glittering: Shining with bright flashes of light (चमचमाता हुआ)
• Lackluster: Dull; lacking brightness (फीका / निस्तेज)
• Darkened: Made dark (अंधकारमय)
• Quiet: Making little noise (शांत)
• Gleaming: Shining brightly (चमकता हुआ)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
FAINT [SSC Selection Post (10th) 23/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Faint means barely perceptible, lacking strength, or weak.
Weak directly matches the meaning of lacking intensity or physical strength.
Other options: Strong, Bright, and Loud express intense or opposite qualities.
Vocab Meanings:
• Faint: Weak; not clear (मंद / कमज़ोर)
• Strong: Powerful (मज़बूत)
• Weak: Lacking strength (कमज़ोर)
• Bright: Giving out a lot of light (चमकीला)
• Loud: Producing a lot of noise (तेज़ आवाज़ वाला)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
PRECISE [SSC Selection Post (10th) 24/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Precise means marked by exactness and accuracy of expression or detail.
Hence, Accurate is the correct synonym.
Other options: 'Imprecise', 'Wrong', and 'Incorrect' are antonyms of precise.
Vocab Meanings:
• Precise: Exact and accurate (सटीक / सही)
• Wrong: Not correct (गलत)
• Imprecise: Not exact (असटीक)
• Accurate: Correct in every detail (सटीक / शुद्ध)
• Incorrect: Not right (अशुद्ध)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
SQUANDER [SSC Selection Post (10th) 24/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Squander means to waste something (especially money or time) in a reckless and foolish manner.
Dissipate means to squander or fritter away (resources or energy).
Other options: 'Collect', 'Assemble', and 'Cluster' denote gathering or bringing together, which are antonymous in context.
Vocab Meanings:
• Squander: To waste money or resources (फिज़ूलखर्ची करना / बर्बाद करना)
• Cluster: A group of similar things together (गुच्छा / समूह)
• Dissipate: To waste or scatter (उड़ा देना / नष्ट करना)
• Collect: To gather together (इकट्ठा करना)
• Assemble: To bring together in one place (एकत्र करना)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
OBEDIENT [SSC Selection Post (10th) 25/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Obedient means willing to comply with orders or respect authority.
Compliant means disposed to agree with others or obey rules, making it the appropriate synonym.
Defiant, Rebellious, and Unruly are antonyms meaning disobedient or resistant.
Vocab Meanings:
• Obedient: Willing to obey (आज्ञाकारी)
• Defiant: Openly refusing to obey (अवज्ञाकारी / उद्दंड)
• Rebellious: Showing resistance to authority (विद्रोही)
• Unruly: Disorderly; hard to control (अनियंत्रित / उपद्रवी)
• Compliant: Willing to obey rules (आज्ञाकारी / अनुपालक)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
FRENZY [SSC Selection Post (10th) 25/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Frenzy refers to a state or period of uncontrolled excitement, wild behavior, or violent agitation.
Rampage refers to a period of wild and disruptive or violent behavior, matching the sense of uncontrolled frenzy.
Stillness, Tranquility, and Serenity all signify calm and peaceful states.
Vocab Meanings:
• Frenzy: A state of wild excitement (उन्माद / पागलपन)
• Stillness: The state of being calm and silent (निश्चलता)
• Tranquility: A state of peace and calm (शांति)
• Serenity: Calmness and peace (प्रशांति / स्थिरता)
• Rampage: Violent and uncontrolled behaviour (उत्पात / हिंसक उपद्रव)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The rebels held a clandestine meeting in the forest to plan their next move. [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 17/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Clandestine means kept secret or done secretly. Overt means done or shown openly and not secret, making it the exact antonym.
Covert, Hidden, and Secret are all synonyms of clandestine.
Vocab Meanings:
• Clandestine: Secret and hidden (गुप्त / चोरी-छिपे)
• Overt: Done openly; not secret (खुला / प्रत्यक्ष)
• Covert: Secret; not openly shown (छिपा हुआ / गुप्त)
• Hidden: Kept out of sight (छिपा हुआ)
• Secret: Known only to a few (गुप्त)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The military operation was aborted due to the sudden change in weather. [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 17/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Aborted means terminated prematurely before completion or unsuccessful. The antonym is Successful, which indicates that an objective was accomplished.
Failed, Vain, and Futile align closely in meaning with aborted.
Vocab Meanings:
• Aborted: Stopped before completion (बीच में रोका गया / निष्फल)
• Successful: Achieving the desired result (सफल)
• Failed: Not successful (असफल)
• Vain: Useless; without result (व्यर्थ)
• Futile: Useless; pointless (निरर्थक)

question.en: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word "Courteous". [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 18/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Meaning: Courteous means polite, respectful, or considerate in manner.
The direct antonym is insolent, which means showing a rude and arrogant lack of respect.
Other options:
• Arrogant: having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance.
• Ashamed: embarrassed or guilty because of one's actions.
• Ignorant: lacking knowledge or awareness.
Vocab Meanings:
• Courteous: Polite and respectful (विनम्र / शिष्ट)
• Insolent: Rude and disrespectful (उद्दंड / अशिष्ट)
• Arrogant: Thinking too highly of oneself (अहंकारी)
• Ashamed: Feeling shame (लज्जित)
• Ignorant: Lacking knowledge (अज्ञानी)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The critic's review was scathing, leaving the director upset. [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 19/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Meaning: Scathing means severely critical, biting, or harsh.
Antonym: Complimentary means expressing praise or admiration.
Other options: Devastating, Harsh, and Caustic are synonyms of scathing.
Vocab Meanings:
• Scathing: Severely critical (तीखा / कटु)
• Devastating: Causing great damage or shock (विनाशकारी)
• Harsh: Severe; cruel (कठोर)
• Caustic: Bitterly sarcastic; burning (तीखा / चुभने वाला)
• Complimentary: Expressing praise (प्रशंसात्मक)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
Geoff was ecstatic after the team won two-nil. [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 19/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Meaning: Ecstatic means feeling or expressing overwhelming happiness or joyful excitement.
Antonym: Miserable means wretchedly unhappy or dejected.
Other options: Elated, Thrilled, and Happy are synonyms of ecstatic.
Vocab Meanings:
• Ecstatic: Extremely happy (अत्यंत प्रसन्न / आनंदित)
• Elated: Very happy and proud (उल्लसित)
• Thrilled: Very excited and pleased (रोमांचित)
• Miserable: Very unhappy (दुखी / उदास)
• Happy: Pleased; glad (खुश)

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Dilatory [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 21/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Meaning: Dilatory means slow to act, unhurried, or intended to cause delay.
Antonym: Prompt means done without delay; immediate or punctual.
Other options:
• Tardy, Delaying, and Slow are synonyms of dilatory.
Vocab Meanings:
• Dilatory: Slow; tending to delay (विलंबकारी / सुस्त)
• Tardy: Late; slow (देरी करने वाला)
• Prompt: Done quickly; on time (तत्पर / तुरंत)
• Delaying: Causing a delay (देरी करने वाला)
• Slow: Not fast (धीमा)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The mountain air was invigorating for the tired hikers. [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 22/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Meaning: Invigorating means making one feel strong, healthy, and full of energy.
The direct antonym is Exhausting, which means causing severe fatigue and draining energy.
Options a, b, and d (Energizing, Bracing, Refreshing) are all synonyms of invigorating.
Vocab Meanings:
• Invigorating: Giving strength and energy (स्फूर्तिदायक / ताज़गी देने वाला)
• Energizing: Giving energy (ऊर्जा देने वाला)
• Bracing: Fresh and cold in a pleasant way (ताज़गी भरा)
• Exhausting: Making very tired (थकाने वाला)
• Refreshing: Making one feel fresh (ताज़गी देने वाला)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The manager took every opportunity to extol the virtues of his hardworking staff. [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 22/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Meaning: Extol means to praise enthusiastically and lavishly.
The opposite is Condemn, which means to express complete disapproval of or censure severely.
Options a, b, and c (Praise, Applaud, Celebrate) are synonyms of extol.
Vocab Meanings:
• Extol: To praise highly (प्रशंसा करना / गुणगान करना)
• Praise: To express approval (प्रशंसा करना)
• Applaud: To clap or praise (सराहना करना)
• Celebrate: To honour or mark with festivity (उत्सव मनाना / सराहना)
• Condemn: To express strong disapproval (निंदा करना)

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Ineluctable [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 23/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Meaning: Ineluctable means unable to be resisted or avoided; inescapable. Hence, avoidable is the exact antonym.
Other options:
• Inevitable / Certain / Unavoidable: Synonyms of ineluctable.
Vocab Meanings:
• Ineluctable: Impossible to avoid (अपरिहार्य / जिससे बचा न जा सके)
• Avoidable: That can be avoided (टाला जा सकने वाला)
• Inevitable: Certain to happen (अनिवार्य / अवश्यंभावी)
• Certain: Sure; definite (निश्चित)
• Unavoidable: Impossible to avoid (अपरिहार्य)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
She has an innate ability to solve complex mathematical problems. [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 24/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Meaning: Innate means inborn or natural.
Therefore, the opposite is Acquired (gained through effort or experience).
'Natural', 'Inborn', and 'Hereditary' are synonyms of innate.
Vocab Meanings:
• Innate: Natural; present from birth (जन्मजात / स्वाभाविक)
• Natural: Existing in nature; inborn (प्राकृतिक / स्वाभाविक)
• Acquired: Gained or learned (अर्जित)
• Inborn: Present from birth (जन्मजात)
• Hereditary: Passed from parents to children (वंशानुगत)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.
The politician claimed his rivals were trying to traduce his reputation. [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 24/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Meaning: Traduce means to speak badly of or tell lies about someone to damage their reputation.
'Slander', 'Defame', and 'Malign' are synonyms.
Therefore, the correct antonym is Exalt, which means to praise or elevate highly.
Vocab Meanings:
• Traduce: To say bad and false things about someone (बदनाम करना / निंदा करना)
• Slander: To make false damaging statements (बदनामी करना)
• Defame: To damage someone's reputation (मानहानि करना)
• Malign: To speak badly of (कलंकित करना)
• Exalt: To praise highly; to raise in rank (महिमामंडन करना / ऊँचा उठाना)

question.en: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Contumacious [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 25/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Meaning: Contumacious means stubbornly or willfully disobedient to authority.
• Antonym: Obedient means complying or willing to comply with orders or requests; submissive to authority.
Other options:
• Stubborn: Having or showing dogged determination not to change one's attitude (synonym).
• Rebellious: Showing a desire to resist authority, control, or convention (synonym).
• Defiant: Openly resisting or refusing to obey (synonym).
Vocab Meanings:
• Contumacious: Stubbornly disobedient (अवज्ञाकारी / हठी)
• Stubborn: Refusing to change one's mind (ज़िद्दी)
• Rebellious: Showing resistance to authority (विद्रोही)
• Obedient: Willing to obey (आज्ञाकारी)
• Defiant: Openly resisting (उद्दंड)

• Lasting: Continuing for a long time (टिकाऊ)

• Stable: Firm; not likely to change (स्थिर)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
VINDICTIVE [SSC Selection Post (12th) 16/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Meaning: Vindictive means having or showing a strong desire for revenge.
Antonym: Forgiving means ready and willing to pardon mistakes or offenses.
Other options: Revengeful, Spiteful, and Malicious are all synonyms of vindictive.
Vocab Meanings:

• Revengeful: Eager for revenge (प्रतिशोधी)
• Forgiving: Ready to pardon (क्षमाशील)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
ABOLISH [SSC Selection Post (12th) 17/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Meaning: 'Abolish' means to formally put an end to a system, law, or custom. Its antonym is establish, meaning to institute, set up, or bring into existence.
Other options ('annul', 'terminate', 'eradicate') are direct synonyms of abolish.
Vocab Meanings:
• Abolish: To end a law or system officially (समाप्त करना / उन्मूलन करना)
• Annul: To declare invalid (रद्द करना)
• Establish: To set up; to found (स्थापित करना)
• Terminate: To bring to an end (समाप्त करना)
• Eradicate: To destroy completely (जड़ से मिटाना)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
ENLIGHTENED [SSC Selection Post (12th) 17/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Meaning: 'Enlightened' denotes possessing rational understanding, knowledge, and progressive awareness. Its antonym is ignorant, which means lacking knowledge, education, or awareness.
Other options ('educated', 'reasonable', 'civilized') share synonymous or positive connotations.
Vocab Meanings:
• Enlightened: Having knowledge and understanding (प्रबुद्ध / ज्ञानी)
• Educated: Having received education (शिक्षित)
• Ignorant: Lacking knowledge (अज्ञानी / अनपढ़)
• Reasonable: Fair and sensible (तर्कसंगत)
• Civilized: Socially and culturally advanced (सभ्य)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
ABUNDANT [SSC Selection Post (12th) 18/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Meaning: 'Abundant' means existing or available in large quantities; plentiful.
'Scarce' means insufficient for the demand; rare or deficient in quantity, making it the exact antonym.
Other options: 'Plenty', 'Ample', and 'Enough' are synonyms indicating sufficiency or abundance.
Vocab Meanings:
• Abundant: Existing in large amounts (प्रचुर / भरपूर)
• Scarce: In short supply (दुर्लभ / कम)
• Plenty: A large amount (बहुतायत)
• Ample: Enough or more than enough (पर्याप्त से अधिक)
• Enough: As much as needed (काफ़ी)

question.en:
Read the following sentence: The spectators reacted strongly to the rebarbative qualities of the actor's rendition.
Determine the meaning of the word "rebarbative" as used in this specific context.
From the given alternatives, choose the term that represents the opposite of that meaning. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 18/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Meaning: 'Rebarbative' means causing annoyance, irritation, or aversion; repulsive and unpleasant.
The opposite of repulsive or unpleasant is Attractive.
'Repellent', 'Offensive', and 'Unpleasant' are synonyms of rebarbative.
Vocab Meanings:
• Rebarbative: Unattractive and unpleasant (अप्रिय / घृणित)
• Repellent: Causing strong dislike (घृणित / विकर्षक)
• Attractive: Pleasing; charming (आकर्षक)
• Offensive: Causing offence (आपत्तिजनक)
• Unpleasant: Not pleasant (अप्रिय)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
COURAGE [SSC Selection Post (12th) 19/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Meaning: Courage means the ability to do something that frightens one; bravery.
Fear is the direct antonym as it denotes an unpleasant emotion caused by threat of danger.
Bravery, boldness, and strength are synonyms or related positive attributes.
Vocab Meanings:
• Courage: The ability to face danger without fear (साहस)
• Fear: An unpleasant feeling caused by danger (भय / डर)
• Bravery: Courage (वीरता)
• Boldness: The quality of being brave (निर्भीकता)
• Strength: The quality of being strong (शक्ति)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
LOQUACIOUS [SSC Selection Post (12th) 19/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Meaning: Loquacious means tending to talk a great deal; talkative.
Reserved is the exact antonym as it describes someone slow to reveal emotion or quiet.
Talkative, wordy, and garrulous are synonyms meaning excessively communicative.
Vocab Meanings:
• Loquacious: Very talkative (बातूनी / वाचाल)
• Talkative: Talking a lot (बातूनी)
• Reserved: Shy; slow to reveal feelings; quiet (अल्पभाषी / संकोची)
• Wordy: Using too many words (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण)
• Garrulous: Excessively talkative (बकवादी)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
MONOTONY [SSC Selection Post (12th) 21/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Meaning: Monotony means lack of variety and interest; tedious repetition and routine.
Therefore, its most appropriate antonym is Variety, which denotes diversity, change, and absence of uniformity.
Other options:
• Sameness, Boredom, and Uniformity are synonyms or closely related in meaning to monotony.
Vocab Meanings:
• Monotony: Dull sameness (एकरसता / नीरसता)
• Variety: The quality of being different or diverse (विविधता)
• Sameness: Lack of change; similarity (समानता / एकरूपता)
• Boredom: Feeling of being bored (ऊब)
• Uniformity: The state of being the same throughout (एकरूपता)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
FEARLESS [SSC Selection Post (12th) 22/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Meaning: Fearless means showing a lack of fear; courageous and brave.
The exact antonym is timid, which means showing a lack of courage or easily frightened.
Other options: Bold, Heroic, and Brave are synonyms of fearless.
Vocab Meanings:
• Fearless: Without fear (निडर)
• Bold: Brave; willing to take risks (साहसी)
• Timid: Easily frightened (डरपोक)
• Heroic: Very brave (वीरतापूर्ण)
• Brave: Showing courage (बहादुर)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
METICULOUS [SSC Selection Post (12th) 22/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Meaning: Meticulous means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
The exact antonym is careless, which means not giving sufficient attention or thought.
Other options: Careful, Diligent, and Thorough are synonyms of meticulous.
Vocab Meanings:
• Meticulous: Very careful about details (अत्यंत सावधान)
• Careful: Taking care (सावधान)
• Diligent: Hard-working and careful (परिश्रमी)
• Thorough: Complete and detailed (पूर्ण / गहन)
• Careless: Not taking care (लापरवाह)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
ANCIENT [SSC Selection Post (12th) 23/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Meaning: Ancient refers to belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence or very old.
Modern means relating to the present or recent times as opposed to the remote past, making it the exact antonym.
Other options: Old, historic, and primitive are synonyms or closely related in meaning to ancient.
Vocab Meanings:
• Ancient: Very old; from long ago (प्राचीन)
• Old: Having lived or existed long (पुराना)
• Historic: Important in history (ऐतिहासिक)
• Modern: Of the present time (आधुनिक)
• Primitive: Very simple; early in development (आदिम)

question.en:
Read the following sentence: The professor criticized the essay as jejune, calling it naive, simplistic, and dull.
Determine the meaning of the word "jejune" as used in this specific context.
From the given alternatives, choose the term that represents the opposite of that meaning. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 23/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Meaning: In the context of writing and intellect, jejune means naive, simplistic, immature, or lacking depth and interest.
Sophisticated means developed to a high degree of complexity, intellectual depth, and refinement, making it the direct antonym.
Other options: Puerile (childish/immature), insipid (lacking flavor/interest), and vapid (dull/uninspiring) are synonyms of jejune.
Vocab Meanings:
• Jejune: Naive, simple and dull (नीरस / बचकाना)
• Sophisticated: Refined; complex; worldly-wise (परिष्कृत / परिपक्व)
• Puerile: Childish and silly (बचकाना)
• Insipid: Lacking flavour or interest (फीका / नीरस)
• Vapid: Lacking interest; dull (नीरस / बेजान)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
PERILOUS [SSC Selection Post (12th) 24/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Meaning: Perilous means full of danger or risk.
Beneficial means producing good or helpful results, which is the direct opposite.
Dangerous, Hazardous, and Risky are synonyms of perilous.
Vocab Meanings:
• Perilous: Full of danger (खतरनाक / जोखिम भरा)
• Dangerous: Likely to cause harm (खतरनाक)
• Hazardous: Full of risk (जोखिमपूर्ण)
• Risky: Involving the chance of danger (जोखिम भरा)
• Beneficial: Helpful; useful (लाभदायक)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
NECESSITY [SSC Selection Post (12th) 25/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Meaning: Necessity refers to an indispensable thing or an unavoidable requirement.
Antonym: Luxury denotes an inessential, desirable item that is expensive or difficult to obtain.
The words 'Requirement', 'Essential', and 'Necessary' are synonyms.
Vocab Meanings:
• Necessity: Something that is needed (आवश्यकता)
• Requirement: Something needed (आवश्यकता)
• Essential: Absolutely necessary (अनिवार्य)
• Luxury: Great comfort; something costly but not needed (विलासिता)
• Necessary: Needed; required (ज़रूरी)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
STIMULATE [SSC Selection Post (12th) 25/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Meaning: Stimulate means to encourage development or increased activity.
Antonym: Discourage means to cause someone to lose confidence or deter an activity.
The options 'Encourage', 'Energize', and 'Motivate' are synonyms of stimulate.

• Stimulate: To encourage activity or interest (प्रोत्साहित करना / उत्तेजित करना)

• Encourage: To give support and confidence (प्रोत्साहित करना)
• Energize: To give energy (ऊर्जावान बनाना)
• Motivate: To make someone want to act (प्रेरित करना)

question.en:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
ZEALOUS [SSC Selection Post (12th) 26/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Meaning: Zealous means showing great energy, enthusiasm, or passion for a cause or objective.
Antonym: Indifferent means having no particular interest, enthusiasm, or concern; unconcerned.
Other options: Passionate, fanatical, and devoted are synonyms or closely related in meaning to zealous.
Vocab Meanings:
• Zealous: Very enthusiastic and eager (उत्साही / जोशीला)
• Passionate: Having strong feelings (भावुक / जोशीला)
• Fanatical: Extremely enthusiastic; extreme (कट्टर)
• Indifferent: Not interested; not caring (उदासीन)
• Devoted: Very loving or loyal (समर्पित)

question.en: Choose the antonym of "Vigilant". [SSC Selection Post (10th) 16/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: 'Vigilant' means keeping careful watch for possible danger or difficulties.
Its antonym is Negligent, meaning failing to take proper care over something.
'Watchful', 'Alert', and 'Attentive' are synonyms of vigilant.
Vocab Meanings:
• Vigilant: Carefully watching for danger (सतर्क / चौकस)
• Watchful: Keeping a close watch (चौकन्ना)
• Negligent: Careless; not giving proper attention (लापरवाह)
• Alert: Quick to notice danger (सजग)
• Attentive: Paying close attention (ध्यान देने वाला)

question.en: Choose the antonym of "Unresolved". [SSC Selection Post (10th) 16/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: 'Unresolved' means not having been resolved, settled, or cleared up.
The antonym is Settled, which means decided, resolved, or established.
'Pending', 'Doubtful', and 'Inconclusive' are all similar in meaning to unresolved.
Vocab Meanings:
• Unresolved: Not settled or solved (अनसुलझा)
• Pending: Waiting to be decided (लंबित)
• Doubtful: Uncertain (संदिग्ध)
• Settled: Decided or solved (निपटाया हुआ / सुलझा हुआ)

question.en: Choose the antonym of Permanent. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 17/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Permanent means lasting or intended to last indefinitely; its opposite is Temporary, meaning lasting for only a limited period.
'Lasting', 'Constant', and 'Fixed' are synonyms of permanent.
Vocab Meanings:
• Permanent: Lasting for ever or for a very long time (स्थायी)
• Lasting: Continuing for a long time (टिकाऊ)
• Temporary: Lasting only for a short time (अस्थायी)
• Constant: Not changing; continuous (निरंतर)
• Fixed: Fastened; not changing (स्थिर / निश्चित)

question.en: Choose the antonym of Meticulous. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 17/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Meticulous means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
Its direct antonym is Negligent, which means failing to take proper care.
Vocab Meanings:
• Meticulous: Showing great attention to detail (अत्यंत सावधान / बारीकी से काम करने वाला)
• Careful: Taking care to avoid mistakes (सावधान)
• Precise: Exact and accurate (सटीक)
• Negligent: Careless; not taking proper care (लापरवाह)
• Thorough: Complete and detailed (पूर्ण / गहन)

question.en: Choose the antonym of 'Dauntless'. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 18/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Dauntless means showing fearlessness and determination. Its direct antonym is Timid, which means showing a lack of courage or easily frightened. 'Bold', 'Fearless', and 'Resolute' are synonyms of the word.
Vocab Meanings:
• Dauntless: Showing no fear (निडर)
• Bold: Brave and confident (साहसी)
• Timid: Easily frightened; shy (डरपोक)
• Fearless: Without fear (निर्भय)
• Resolute: Determined; firm in purpose (दृढ़ निश्चयी)

question.en: Choose the antonym of "Relevance". [SSC Selection Post (10th) 18/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Relevance denotes the quality of being closely connected or appropriate to the matter at hand. Adding the negative prefix 'ir-' forms Irrelevance, which is the direct antonym. 'Significance', 'Applicability', and 'Pertinence' are synonyms.
Vocab Meanings:
• Relevance: The quality of being connected to the matter (प्रासंगिकता)
• Significance: Importance (महत्व)
• Applicability: The quality of being suitable to use (प्रयोज्यता)
• Irrelevance: The quality of not being connected (अप्रासंगिकता)
• Pertinence: Relevance to the subject (उपयुक्तता / प्रासंगिकता)

question.en: Choose the antonym of "Prudent". [SSC Selection Post (10th) 19/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Prudent means acting with or showing care and thought for the future (wise, cautious).
Antonym: Reckless means heedless of danger or consequences, making it the direct antonym.
Other options: Careful, Sensible, and Judicious are synonyms of prudent.
Vocab Meanings:
• Prudent: Careful and wise in planning (विवेकशील / समझदार)
• Reckless: Acting without thinking of danger (लापरवाह / उतावला)
• Careful: Avoiding risks or mistakes (सावधान)
• Sensible: Showing good judgement (समझदार)
• Judicious: Having good judgement (विवेकपूर्ण)

question.en: Choose the antonym of Amplify. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 19/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Amplify means to increase the volume, size, strength, or effect of something.
Antonym: Reduce means to make smaller or lessen in degree or size.
Other options: Increase, Expand, and Enhance are synonyms.
Vocab Meanings:
• Amplify: To make larger or louder (बढ़ाना / विस्तार करना)
• Increase: To make greater (बढ़ाना)
• Expand: To become larger (फैलाना)
• Reduce: To make smaller or less (घटाना / कम करना)
• Enhance: To improve or increase (वृद्धि करना)

question.en: Choose the antonym of Abundant. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 21/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: 'Abundant' means existing or available in large quantities; plentiful.
Its exact opposite is Scarce, meaning insufficient or in short supply.
'Plentiful', 'Ample', and 'Sufficient' are synonyms of abundant.
Vocab Meanings:
• Abundant: More than enough; plentiful (प्रचुर / भरपूर)
• Plentiful: Existing in large amounts (बहुतायत में)
• Scarce: In short supply (दुर्लभ / कम)
• Ample: Enough or more than enough (पर्याप्त से अधिक)
• Sufficient: Enough for a purpose (पर्याप्त)

question.en: Choose the antonym of "Kinetic". [SSC Selection Post (10th) 21/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: 'Kinetic' relates to or results from motion.
The correct antonym is Static, which means stationary, motionless, or lacking movement.
'Active', 'Moving', and 'Dynamic' denote movement or activity.
Vocab Meanings:
• Kinetic: Relating to motion (गतिज / गतिशील)
• Active: Busy and energetic (सक्रिय)
• Static: Not moving or changing (स्थिर)
• Moving: In motion (गतिमान)
• Dynamic: Full of energy and change (गतिशील)

question.en: Choose the antonym of "Tangible". [SSC Selection Post (10th) 22/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Tangible means perceptible by touch or clear and definite.
Intangible means unable to be touched or not having physical presence, which is its exact antonym.
'Concrete', 'Palpable', and 'Material' are synonyms of tangible.
Vocab Meanings:
• Tangible: Real; can be touched (मूर्त / स्पर्शनीय)
• Intangible: Cannot be touched; not physical (अमूर्त / अस्पृश्य)
• Concrete: Solid; real (ठोस)
• Palpable: So strong it can almost be felt (स्पर्शगम्य / स्पष्ट)
• Material: Physical; made of matter (भौतिक)

question.en: Choose the antonym of Ephemeral. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 22/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time.
Eternal means lasting or existing forever without end, making it the antonym.
'Temporary', 'Fleeting', and 'Short-lived' are synonyms of ephemeral.
Vocab Meanings:
• Ephemeral: Lasting a very short time (क्षणभंगुर / अल्पकालिक)
• Temporary: Not permanent (अस्थायी)
• Fleeting: Passing quickly (क्षणिक)
• Eternal: Lasting for ever (शाश्वत / अनंत)
• Short-lived: Existing only for a short time (अल्पायु)

question.en: Choose the antonym of "Impartial". [SSC Selection Post (10th) 23/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Impartial means treating all rivals or disputants equally; fair and unbiased.
The antonym is Biased, meaning unfairly prejudiced for or against someone or something.
Other options: Fair, Neutral, and Objective are synonyms of impartial.
Vocab Meanings:

• Biased: Unfairly supporting one side (पक्षपाती)
• Fair: Just and reasonable (न्यायसंगत)
• Neutral: Not supporting either side (तटस्थ)
• Objective: Not influenced by personal feelings (वस्तुनिष्ठ)

question.en: Choose the antonym of Lucid. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 23/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Lucid means expressed clearly or easy to understand.
The antonym is Confusing, which means bewildering or difficult to understand.
Other options: Clear, Transparent, and Obvious are synonyms of lucid.
Vocab Meanings:
• Lucid: Clear and easy to understand (स्पष्ट / सुबोध)
• Clear: Easy to understand (स्पष्ट)
• Transparent: See-through; open (पारदर्शी)
• Confusing: Causing confusion (भ्रमित करने वाला)
• Obvious: Easily seen or understood (स्पष्ट / ज़ाहिर)

question.en: Choose the antonym of Hostile. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 24/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Hostile means showing or feeling active opposition or unfriendliness.
Its opposite is Friendly, which means kind, pleasant, or supportive.
Other options: 'Aggressive', 'Violent', and 'Harsh' are synonyms of hostile.
Vocab Meanings:
• Hostile: Unfriendly; showing enmity (शत्रुतापूर्ण)
• Aggressive: Ready to attack (आक्रामक)
• Friendly: Friendly; kind (मैत्रीपूर्ण)
• Violent: Using physical force (हिंसक)
• Harsh: Cruel; severe (कठोर)

question.en: Choose the antonym of Benevolent. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 24/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Benevolent means well-meaning, kindly, and charitable.

Other options: 'Kind', 'Charitable', and 'Generous' are synonyms of benevolent.
Vocab Meanings:
• Benevolent: Kind and helpful (परोपकारी / दयालु)
