• Generous: Willing to give more than needed (उदार)

question.en: Choose the antonym of Bold. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 25/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Bold means brave, confident, and willing to take risks.
Timid means easily frightened or lacking courage, making it the correct antonym.
Courageous, Fearless, and Daring are synonyms of bold.
Vocab Meanings:
• Bold: Brave; willing to take risks (साहसी)
• Courageous: Brave (बहादुर)
• Fearless: Without fear (निडर)
• Timid: Easily frightened (डरपोक)
• Daring: Willing to do dangerous things (दुस्साहसी)

question.en: Choose the antonym of Obsolete. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 25/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Meaning: Obsolete means no longer produced or used; out of date.
Modern means relating to the present or recent times; up-to-date, serving as the opposite.
Outdated, Ancient, and Archaic are synonyms signifying old or outmoded things.
Vocab Meanings:
• Obsolete: No longer used; out of date (अप्रचलित / पुराना)
• Outdated: Old-fashioned (पुराना)
• Ancient: Very old; from long ago (प्राचीन)
• Modern: Of the present time (आधुनिक)
• Archaic: Very old or old-fashioned (पुरातन)

tests.title: Selection Post 2026 English — ONE WORD SUBSTITUTION

meta.title: Selection Post 2026 English — ONE WORD SUBSTITUTION
meta.subject: English

question.en:
Choose the alternative which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
The scientific study of stars and planets: [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 17/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial bodies like stars, planets, comets, and galaxies.
Gastronomy is the practice or art of choosing, cooking, and eating good food; Biology is the study of living organisms; Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures.
Vocab Meanings:
• Astronomy: The scientific study of stars and planets (खगोल विज्ञान)
• Gastronomy: The art of good eating and cooking (पाक-कला / भोजन विज्ञान)
• Biology: The study of living things (जीव विज्ञान)
• Anthropology: The study of human societies and cultures (मानव विज्ञान)

question.en:
Choose the alternative which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
The study of the hereditary transmission and variation of inherited characteristics: [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 17/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Genetics is the branch of biology concerned with heredity and the variation of inherited traits in organisms.
Pathology is the study of disease causes and effects; Linguistics is the study of language; Ecology is the study of organisms and their environment.
Vocab Meanings:
• Genetics: The study of heredity and genes (आनुवंशिकी)
• Pathology: The study of diseases (रोग विज्ञान)
• Linguistics: The study of language (भाषा विज्ञान)
• Ecology: The study of living things and their environment (पारिस्थितिकी)

question.en:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for the following description.
A person who actively opposes or is hostile to someone or something. [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 18/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Antagonist refers to a person who actively opposes or is hostile to someone or something.
Other options:
• Protagonist: the main figure or a prominent actor in a real situation or story.
• Philanthropist: a person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by donating money.
• Optimist: a person disposed to take a favorable view of events or conditions.
Vocab Meanings:
• Antagonist: A person who opposes someone (विरोधी / प्रतिपक्षी)
• Protagonist: The main character in a story (नायक / मुख्य पात्र)
• Philanthropist: A person who gives money to help others (परोपकारी / लोकोपकारी)
• Optimist: A person who expects good things (आशावादी)

question.en: What is the one-word substitution for a place where children without parents are cared for and brought up? [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 18/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
An orphanage is a residential institution devoted to the care and upbringing of orphans (children whose parents are deceased or unable to care for them).
Other options:
• Hospital: an institution providing medical and surgical treatment.
• School: an institution for educating children.
• Asylum: an institution offering shelter and support to mentally ill or vulnerable people.
Vocab Meanings:
• Orphanage: A home for children without parents (अनाथालय)
• Hospital: A place where sick people are treated (अस्पताल)
• School: A place where children are taught (विद्यालय)
• Asylum: Protection or refuge; a mental hospital (old use) (शरण / पागलखाना)

question.en:
Choose the alternative which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
A job or position requiring little or no work, but with good pay: [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 19/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Sinecure refers to a paid position that involves little to no real work or responsibility.
Other options: Colonel is a senior military officer rank; President is the elected head of a state or organization; Politician is a person involved in politics.
Vocab Meanings:
• Sinecure: A job with high pay but little work (कम काम और अधिक वेतन वाला पद)
• Colonel: An army officer of high rank (कर्नल - सैन्य पद)
• President: The head of a country or organisation (राष्ट्रपति / अध्यक्ष)
• Politician: A person active in politics (राजनेता)

question.en:
Choose the alternative which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
An instrument used for measuring the force of the pulse: [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 19/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Sphygmomanometer (or sphygmometer) is an instrument used for measuring arterial blood pressure and pulse strength.
Other options: Galvanometer measures electric current; Thermometer measures temperature; Hydrometer measures the relative density of liquids.
Vocab Meanings:
• Sphygmomanometer: An instrument for measuring blood pressure/pulse force (रक्तचाप / नाड़ी दाब मापक यंत्र)
• Galvanometer: An instrument for detecting electric current (धारामापी)
• Thermometer: An instrument for measuring temperature (तापमापी)
• Hydrometer: An instrument for measuring liquid density (द्रवघनत्वमापी)

question.en: What is the correct one-word substitution for "the complete final destruction of the world, as described in religious texts or believed to happen in the future"? [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 21/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Apocalypse: The complete final destruction of the world, especially as described in biblical or prophetic accounts.
Other options:
• Renaissance: A revival of or renewed interest in something, especially art and literature.
• Utopia: An imagined place or state of things in which everything is perfect.
• Euphoria: A feeling or state of intense excitement and happiness.
Vocab Meanings:
• Apocalypse: The complete destruction of the world (प्रलय / सर्वनाश)
• Renaissance: A revival of art and learning (पुनर्जागरण)
• Utopia: An imaginary perfect society (आदर्शलोक / काल्पनिक आदर्श समाज)
• Euphoria: A feeling of intense happiness (अत्यधिक प्रसन्नता / उल्लास)

question.en: Which of the following is a one-word substitution for a long narrative poem, typically detailing the heroic deeds and adventures of a legendary figure? [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 21/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Epic: A long narrative poem narrating the deeds and adventures of heroic or legendary figures.
Other options:
• Ode: A lyrical poem typically of elaborate or irregular metrical form and expressive of exalted or enthusiastic emotion.
• Sonnet: A poem of fourteen lines using any of a number of formal rhyme schemes.
• Ballad: A poem or song narrating a story in short stanzas, traditionally of folk origin.
Vocab Meanings:
• Epic: A long poem about heroic deeds (महाकाव्य)
• Ode: A poem addressed to someone or something (संबोधन गीत / स्तुति काव्य)
• Sonnet: A 14-line poem (चतुर्दशपदी / सॉनेट)
• Ballad: A song or poem that tells a story (गाथा गीत / लोकगीत)

question.en:
Choose the alternative which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
A person who studies the stars and planets: [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 22/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Astronomer: A scientist who studies celestial bodies such as stars, planets, comets, and galaxies.
Other options:
• Geologist: A person who studies the physical structure and substance of the earth.
• Cartographer: A person who draws or produces maps.
• Anthropologist: A person who studies human societies, cultures, and development.
Vocab Meanings:
• Astronomer: A person who studies stars and planets (खगोलशास्त्री)
• Geologist: A person who studies rocks and the earth (भूवैज्ञानिक)
• Cartographer: A person who makes maps (मानचित्रकार)
• Anthropologist: A person who studies human societies (मानवविज्ञानी)

question.en:
Choose the alternative which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
The branch of science concerned with the nature, effects, and detection of poisons: [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 22/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Toxicology: The branch of science concerned with the nature, effects, detection, and treatment of poisons.
Other options:
• Oncology: The study and treatment of tumors and cancer.
• Psychology: The scientific study of the human mind and behavior.
• Nephrology: The branch of medicine dealing with the kidneys.
Vocab Meanings:
• Toxicology: The science of poisons (विष विज्ञान)
• Oncology: The study of cancer (कैंसर विज्ञान / अर्बुद विज्ञान)
• Psychology: The study of the mind (मनोविज्ञान)
• Nephrology: The study of kidneys (गुर्दा रोग विज्ञान)

question.en:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for the phrase below:
"An action done by one's own free will, without being forced or paid." [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 23/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Voluntary means done, given, or acting of one's own free will.
Other options:
• Compulsory / Obligatory: Required by law or a rule; mandatory.
• Involuntary: Done without will or conscious control.
Vocab Meanings:
• Voluntary: Done of one's own free will (स्वैच्छिक)
• Compulsory: Required by law or rule (अनिवार्य)
• Obligatory: Required as a duty (बाध्यकारी)
• Involuntary: Done without conscious control (अनैच्छिक)

question.en: Which of the following words refers to the legal right to be the only one to reproduce, publish, and sell a book, musical recording, or other artistic work for a certain period of time? [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 23/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Copyright is the exclusive legal right given to an originator or assignee to print, publish, perform, film, or record literary, artistic, or musical material.
Other options:
• Franchise: An authorization granted to carry out specified commercial activities.
• Patent: A government authority or license conferring a right or title for an invention.
• Trademark: A recognizable sign, design, or expression identifying products or services.
Vocab Meanings:
• Copyright: The legal right to publish and sell creative work (प्रतिलिप्यधिकार / कॉपीराइट)
• Franchise: Official permission to sell a company's products; right to vote (मताधिकार / व्यापार अधिकार)
• Patent: The legal right to an invention (एकस्व / पेटेंट)
• Trademark: A registered symbol or name of a company (व्यापार चिह्न)

question.en:
Choose the alternative which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
A person who is forced to leave their country because of war or persecution: [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 24/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Answer: A Refugee is a person forced to leave their country to escape war, persecution, or natural disaster.
Other options:
• Nomad: A member of a people with no permanent home, moving from place to place.
• Sinecure: A position requiring little or no work but yielding financial benefit.
• Politician: A person involved in party politics or holding public office.
Vocab Meanings:
• Refugee: A person forced to leave their country (शरणार्थी)
• Nomad: A person with no fixed home who moves place to place (खानाबदोश / घुमंतू)
• Sinecure: A job with high pay but little work (कम काम और अधिक वेतन वाला पद)
• Politician: A person active in politics (राजनेता)

question.en:
Choose the alternative which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
A severe snowstorm with high winds and low visibility: [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 24/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Answer: A Blizzard is a severe snowstorm with high winds and intensely reduced visibility.
Other options:
• Earthquake: A sudden violent shaking of the ground.
• Hurricane: A severe tropical cyclone with high-speed winds and heavy rain.
• Tsunami: A series of huge sea waves caused by an underwater earthquake.
Vocab Meanings:
• Blizzard: A severe snowstorm with strong winds (बर्फ़ीला तूफ़ान / हिमझंझा)
• Earthquake: A sudden shaking of the earth (भूकंप)
• Hurricane: A storm with violent wind (चक्रवात / प्रचंड तूफ़ान)
• Tsunami: A huge sea wave (सुनामी / समुद्री लहरें)

question.en: Which of the following words refers to the time of year when day and night are of equal length? [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 25/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Definition: Equinox refers to the time or date (twice each year) at which the sun crosses the celestial equator, when day and night are of approximately equal length.
Other options:
• Solstice: Either of the two times in the year when the sun reaches its highest or lowest point in the sky at noon, marked by the longest and shortest days.
• Zenith: The time at which something is most powerful or successful; the point in the sky directly overhead.
• Eclipse: An obscuring of the light from one celestial body by the passage of another between it and the observer.
Vocab Meanings:
• Equinox: The time when day and night are equal in length (विषुव - दिन और रात बराबर)
• Solstice: The longest or shortest day of the year (संक्रांति / अयनांत)
• Zenith: The highest point (शिखर / चरम बिंदु)
• Eclipse: The blocking of light of one heavenly body by another (ग्रहण)

question.en:
Read the sentence and choose the correct one-word substitution for the underlined part.
The author began her novel with a short quotation at the beginning of the book to set the theme. [SSC Selection Post (Graduate) 25/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Definition: An epigraph is a short quotation or saying at the beginning of a book or chapter, intended to suggest its theme.
Other options:
• Epilogue: A section or speech at the end of a book or play that serves as a comment on or a conclusion to what has happened.
• Prologue: A separate introductory section of a literary, dramatic, or musical work.
• Blurb: A short description of a book, movie, or other product written for promotional purposes.
Vocab Meanings:
• Epigraph: A short quotation at the start of a book (पुस्तक के आरंभ में दिया गया उद्धरण / अभिलेख)
• Epilogue: A section at the end of a book or play (उपसंहार)
• Prologue: An introduction to a book or play (प्रस्तावना)
• Blurb: A short description of a book on its cover (पुस्तक का संक्षिप्त प्रचार विवरण)

question.en:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
A place where grains are stored. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 16/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Definition: A granary is a storehouse or room in a barn for threshed grain or animal feed.
Other options:
• Mint: A place where coins/currency are manufactured.
• Sweatshop: A factory or workshop where employees work at very low wages for long hours.
• Archipelago: An extensive group or cluster of islands.
Vocab Meanings:
• Granary: A storehouse for grain (अन्न भंडार / अनाज का गोदाम)
• Mint: A place where coins are made (टकसाल)
• Sweatshop: A factory where workers are exploited (शोषणकारी कारखाना)
• Archipelago: A group of islands (द्वीपसमूह)

question.en:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
To send someone back to his/her own country. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 16/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Definition: Repatriate means to restore or return someone to their own country of origin.
Other options:
• Depart: To leave or go away.
• Exile: To expel and bar someone from their native country.
• Evacuate: To remove someone from a place of danger to a safe place.
Vocab Meanings:
• Repatriate: To send someone back to their own country (स्वदेश वापस भेजना)
• Depart: To leave (प्रस्थान करना)
• Exile: To force someone to leave their country (निर्वासित करना / देश निकाला)
• Evacuate: To move people out of a dangerous place (खाली कराना / निकालना)

question.en: What is the name of a procedure where a piece of tissue or a sample of cells from the body is removed so that a medical pathologist can examine it? [SSC Selection Post (12th) 17/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Biopsy is the surgical removal of a small sample of living tissue or cells for diagnostic pathological examination.
Other options: An autopsy is a post-mortem examination performed after death; an operation is a generic term for any surgical intervention; an amputation is the surgical severance of a body limb.
Vocab Meanings:
• Biopsy: Removal of tissue from a living body for medical examination (ऊतक परीक्षण / बायोप्सी)
• Autopsy: Examination of a dead body to find the cause of death (शव परीक्षा / पोस्टमार्टम)
• Operation: A surgical procedure (शल्य क्रिया)
• Amputation: Cutting off a body part by surgery (अंग विच्छेदन)

question.en:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
The punishment of being kept in school for hours after classes. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 18/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Detention refers to a disciplinary punishment in school where a student is made to stay behind after normal school hours.
Other options:
• Palliation: Relief of symptoms or pain without curing the underlying disease.
• Ineptitude: Lack of skill or competence.
• Disguise: A means of altering one's appearance to conceal one's identity.
Vocab Meanings:
• Detention: Being kept in school after hours as punishment; custody (स्कूल के बाद रोके जाने की सज़ा / हिरासत)
• Palliation: Making pain or a problem less severe (शमन / पीड़ा कम करना)
• Ineptitude: Lack of skill or ability (अयोग्यता / अक्षमता)
• Disguise: A changed appearance to hide identity (भेष बदलना)

question.en:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
Fear of darkness. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 18/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Nyctophobia is the extreme or irrational fear of the dark or night.
Other options:
• Photophobia: Extreme sensitivity to light.
• Aerophobia: Fear of flying or drafts of air.
• Hemophobia: Fear of blood.
Vocab Meanings:
• Nyctophobia: Fear of darkness (अंधकार का भय)
• Photophobia: Fear of or sensitivity to light (प्रकाश का भय)
• Aerophobia: Fear of flying or air (उड़ान / हवा का भय)
• Hemophobia: Fear of blood (रक्त का भय)

question.en:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
The study of humans, past and present. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 19/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Anthropology is the scientific study of humans, human behaviour, and societies in the past and present.
Other options:
• Psychology: Study of the mind and behaviour.
• Psephology: Statistical study of elections and voting.
• Seismology: Scientific study of earthquakes.
Vocab Meanings:
• Anthropology: The study of human societies and cultures (मानव विज्ञान / नृविज्ञान)
• Psychology: The study of the mind and behaviour (मनोविज्ञान)
• Psephology: The study of elections and voting (चुनाव विज्ञान)
• Seismology: The study of earthquakes (भूकंप विज्ञान)

question.en:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
A system of naming things. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 19/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Nomenclature refers to a system of names or terms used in a particular field of arts or sciences.
Other options:
• Horticulture: The practice of garden cultivation and management.
• Miniature: A thing that is much smaller than normal.
• Genocide: The deliberate killing of a large group of people from a particular nation or ethnic group.
Vocab Meanings:
• Nomenclature: A system of naming things (नामकरण पद्धति)
• Horticulture: The art of growing garden plants (बागवानी / उद्यान विज्ञान)
• Miniature: A very small version of something (लघु रूप / लघुचित्र)
• Genocide: The deliberate killing of a large group of people (नरसंहार)

question.en: What is the art of beautiful handwriting called? [SSC Selection Post (12th) 21/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Calligraphy refers to the art of producing decorative and beautiful handwriting or lettering with a pen or brush.
Other options:
• Typography: The art or procedure of arranging type or printing from types.
• Graffiti: Writing or drawings scribbled, scratched, or sprayed illicitly on a wall or other surface in a public place.
• Cartography: The science or art of drawing maps.
Vocab Meanings:
• Calligraphy: The art of beautiful handwriting (सुलेखन / सुंदर लिखावट की कला)
• Typography: The art of arranging printed text (मुद्रण कला / टाइपोग्राफी)
• Graffiti: Drawings or writing on walls in public (दीवार पर लिखावट / भित्ति चित्र)
• Cartography: The science of making maps (मानचित्र कला)

question.en:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
A place where coins are made. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 21/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Mint is an industrial facility or place where coins, currency, or medals are officially manufactured under government authority.
Other options:
• Granary: A storehouse for threshed grain.
• Arsenal: A place where weapons and military equipment are stored or made.
• Tannery: A place where animal hides are tanned and made into leather.
Vocab Meanings:
• Mint: A place where coins are made (टकसाल)
• Granary: A storehouse for grain (अन्न भंडार)
• Arsenal: A place where weapons are stored (शस्त्रागार)
• Tannery: A place where animal skins are made into leather (चर्मशोधन कारखाना)

question.en:
Choose the one-word substitution for the following sentence.
A job that requires minimal effort yet offers a substantial paycheck. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 22/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Sinecure refers to a position requiring little or no work but yielding the holder financial benefit.
Other options:
Director: A person in charge of an activity, department, or company.
Trustee: An individual or member of a board given control of property in trust.
Ombudsman: An official appointed to investigate individuals' complaints against maladministration.
Vocab Meanings:
• Sinecure: A job with high pay but little work (कम काम और अधिक वेतन वाला पद / आरामदेह नौकरी)
• Director: A person who manages an organisation (निदेशक)
• Trustee: A person who manages property for others (न्यासी)
• Ombudsman: An official who investigates public complaints (लोकपाल)

question.en:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
One who copies from writers is called: [SSC Selection Post (12th) 23/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Plagiarist refers to a person who uses another person's words, ideas, or work and pretends that they are their own.
Other options:
• Critic: A person who expresses an opinion or assessment of the merits of literary or artistic work.
• Historian: An expert who studies and writes about the past.
• Biographer: A person who writes an account of another person's life.
Vocab Meanings:
• Plagiarist: A person who copies another's work as their own (साहित्यिक चोर)
• Critic: A person who judges works of art (आलोचक)
• Historian: An expert in history (इतिहासकार)
• Biographer: A person who writes another's life story (जीवनी लेखक)

question.en:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
The act of showing disrespect towards sacred or holy things. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 23/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Blasphemy refers to the act or offense of speaking sacrilegiously or showing great disrespect toward God, religion, or sacred things.
Other options:
• Atheism: Disbelief or lack of belief in the existence of God or gods.
• Pantheism: A doctrine which identifies God with the universe, or regards the universe as a manifestation of God.
• Innuendo: An indirect or subtle intimation about a person or thing, usually of a derogatory nature.
Vocab Meanings:
• Blasphemy: Disrespect towards God or sacred things (ईशनिंदा / धर्म का अपमान)
• Atheism: Disbelief in God (नास्तिकता)
• Pantheism: The belief that God is in everything (सर्वेश्वरवाद)
• Innuendo: An indirect hint, usually negative (व्यंग्यपूर्ण संकेत / कटाक्ष)

question.en:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
A reasoning method involving two statements from which a conclusion is reached. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 24/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Syllogism is a form of deductive reasoning consisting of a major premise, a minor premise, and a conclusion.
Other options:
• Ambiguous: Open to more than one interpretation.
• Innuendo: An indirect or subtle intimation or hint.
• Episode: An event or occurrence in a larger sequence.
Vocab Meanings:
• Syllogism: A form of reasoning with two premises and a conclusion (न्याय वाक्य / तर्कवाक्य)
• Ambiguous: Having more than one meaning (अस्पष्ट / द्विअर्थी)
• Innuendo: An indirect hint (कटाक्ष / व्यंग्यपूर्ण संकेत)
• Episode: An event or one part of a series (प्रसंग / घटना)

question.en:
Choose the one-word substitution for the underlined phrase in the sentence below.
The king was known for his generous and forgiving treatment of the vanquished opponent. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 24/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Magnanimous means very generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival or someone less powerful.
Other options:
• Mendacious: Untruthful or telling lies.
• Recalcitrant: Stubbornly disobedient or resistant to authority.
• Nefarious: Wicked, villainous, or criminal.
Vocab Meanings:
• Magnanimous: Generous and forgiving (उदार / उदारचित्त)
• Mendacious: Lying; untruthful (झूठा)
• Recalcitrant: Refusing to obey (हठी / अड़ियल)
• Nefarious: Wicked; criminal (दुष्ट / पापपूर्ण)

question.en:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
A sudden involuntary muscle contraction. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 25/09/26 Shift 2]

solution.en:
Definition: A spasm is an involuntary, sudden muscle contraction or twitch.
Other options:
'Palliation' means relief of symptoms without curing the condition.
'Innuendo' refers to an allusive or oblique remark or hint.
'Seismology' is the scientific study of earthquakes.
Vocab Meanings:
• Spasm: A sudden involuntary muscle contraction (ऐंठन / मरोड़)
• Palliation: Easing pain or a problem (शमन / पीड़ा कम करना)
• Innuendo: An indirect hint (कटाक्ष)
• Seismology: The study of earthquakes (भूकंप विज्ञान)

question.en:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, choose the one which can be substituted for the given words/sentence.
A labourer involved in loading and unloading the ships. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 26/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Definition: A stevedore is a person employed at a dock to load and unload cargo from ships.
Other options:
- Plagiarist: A person who copies another person's work without credit.
- Polyglot: A person who knows and uses several languages.
- Nonagenarian: A person who is between 90 and 99 years old.
Vocab Meanings:
• Stevedore: A worker who loads and unloads ships (जहाज़ पर माल लादने-उतारने वाला मज़दूर / कुली)
• Plagiarist: A person who copies another's work (साहित्यिक चोर)
• Polyglot: A person who knows many languages (बहुभाषी)
• Nonagenarian: A person in their nineties (नब्बे वर्षीय व्यक्ति)

question.en:
Choose the one-word substitution for the underlined phrase in the sentence below.
She made a donation out of selfless concern for others. [SSC Selection Post (12th) 26/09/26 Shift 1]

solution.en:
Definition: Altruism is the selfless attitude or practice of concern for the well-being and happiness of other people.
Other options:
- Fastidious: Very attentive to accuracy and detail; hard to please.
- Nefarious: Wicked, evil, or criminal.
- Obsequious: Excessively compliant or servile.
Vocab Meanings:
• Altruism: Selfless concern for others (परोपकार / निःस्वार्थ भावना)
• Fastidious: Very careful about details; hard to please (नखरेबाज़ / मीन-मेख निकालने वाला)
• Nefarious: Wicked; criminal (दुष्ट)
• Obsequious: Too eager to please or obey (चाटुकार / जी-हुज़ूरी करने वाला)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: A person who lives alone. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 16/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
A person living alone or existing alone is described as Solitary.
Other options:
'Mandatory' means compulsory or required by law.
'Truant' is a student who stays away from school without permission.
'Secretive' is someone inclined to conceal feelings or information.
Vocab Meanings:
• Solitary: Living or being alone (अकेला रहने वाला / एकाकी)
• Mandatory: Compulsory; required by rule (अनिवार्य)
• Truant: A student who stays away from school without permission (बिना बताए अनुपस्थित रहने वाला)
• Secretive: Inclined to hide things (गुप्त रखने वाला)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: Free from disturbance or calm. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 16/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Tranquil means free from disturbance; calm and peaceful.
Other options:
'Quill' is a main wing or tail feather of a bird used as a pen.
'Relinquish' means to voluntarily cease to keep or claim; give up.
'Terrific' means of great size, amount, or intensity, or extremely good.
Vocab Meanings:
• Tranquil: Calm and peaceful (शांत / अशांति रहित)
• Quill: A pen made from a feather (पंख की कलम)
• Relinquish: To give up or let go (त्याग देना)
• Terrific: Extremely good; also very great (अत्यंत बढ़िया / भयानक)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: A person considered important due to high rank. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 16/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
A Dignitary is a person considered to be important because of high rank or office.
Other options:
'Valley' is a low area of land between hills or mountains.
'Charity' is an organization set up to help those in need, or benevolent giving.
'Exactly' is an adverb meaning in a precise manner.
Vocab Meanings:
• Dignitary: A person of high rank or official position (उच्च पदस्थ व्यक्ति / गणमान्य व्यक्ति)
• Valley: Low land between hills (घाटी)
• Charity: Giving help to the needy (दान / परोपकार)
• Exactly: Precisely; just (बिल्कुल ठीक)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: A period of ten years. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 17/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Definition: A Decade is a period of ten years.
Other options: 'Century' is a period of one hundred years; 'Millennium' is a period of one thousand years; 'Turgid' means swollen or congested.
Vocab Meanings:
• Decade: A period of ten years (दशक)
• Turgid: Swollen; or (of language) pompous (सूजा हुआ / आडंबरपूर्ण)
• Millennium: A period of a thousand years (सहस्राब्दी)
• Century: A period of a hundred years (शताब्दी)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: "A speech delivered without preparation" is: [SSC Selection Post (10th) 17/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Definition: An Extempore speech is spoken or done without preparation or rehearsal.
Other options: 'Debate' is a formal discussion; 'Lecture' is an educational talk; 'Dialogue' is a conversation between two or more people.
Vocab Meanings:
• Extempore: Spoken without preparation (बिना तैयारी के / आशु भाषण)
• Debate: A formal discussion with opposing arguments (वाद-विवाद)
• Lecture: A formal talk to teach (व्याख्यान)
• Dialogue: A conversation between two or more people (संवाद)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: A companion who shares in one's activities. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 18/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
A companion who shares in one's activities or fellow member of an organisation is a Comrade.
Other options:
• Menagerie: A collection of wild animals kept in captivity for exhibition.
• Didactic: Intended to teach, particularly in having moral instruction as an ulterior motive.
• Pallisade: A fence of wooden stakes or iron railings fixed into the ground.
Vocab Meanings:
• Comrade: A friend or companion who shares activities (साथी / सहयोगी)
• Menagerie: A collection of wild animals (वन्य जीवों का संग्रह / चिड़ियाघर)
• Didactic: Meant to teach a moral lesson (उपदेशात्मक)
• Palisade: A fence of pointed wooden stakes (लकड़ी के खूँटों का बाड़ा)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: A mobile, destructive vortex of rotating winds. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 18/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
A mobile, destructive vortex of violently rotating winds having the appearance of a funnel-shaped cloud is a Tornado.
Other options:
• Torpedo: An underwater self-propelled missile.
• Peduncle: The stalk bearing a flower or fruit, or the main stalk of an inflorescence.
• Truncate: To shorten something by cutting off the top or the end.
Vocab Meanings:
• Tornado: A violent rotating column of wind (बवंडर / चक्रवात)
• Torpedo: An underwater missile (जलमग्न प्रक्षेपास्त्र / टॉरपीडो)
• Peduncle: The stalk of a flower or fruit (पुष्प-वृंत / डंठल)
• Truncate: To shorten by cutting off a part (काटकर छोटा करना)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: An act of defeating an enemy or opponent in a competition. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 18/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
An act of defeating an enemy or opponent in a battle, game, or other competition is a Victory.
Other options:
• Glory: High renown or honour won by notable achievements.
• Transitory: Not permanent; lasting for only a short time.
• Trait: A distinguishing quality or characteristic, typically one belonging to a person.
Vocab Meanings:
• Victory: The act of winning a battle or contest (विजय / जीत)
• Glory: Great fame and honour (गौरव / यश)
• Transitory: Lasting only a short time (क्षणिक / अस्थायी)
• Trait: A quality or characteristic (विशेषता / गुण)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: A song identified with a country or group. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 19/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Anthem is defined as an uplifting song or hymn associated with a particular country, group, or cause.
Other options:
- Totem: A natural object or animal believed by a society to have spiritual significance.
- Portent: A sign or warning that a momentous or calamitous event is likely to happen.
- Sang: Past tense of the verb sing.
Vocab Meanings:
• Anthem: A song of loyalty for a country or group (राष्ट्रगान / गान)
• Totem: A sacred symbol of a tribe or clan (कुल-चिह्न / गणचिह्न)
• Portent: A sign or warning of a future event (अपशकुन / पूर्व संकेत)
• Sang: Past tense of 'sing' (गाया - 'sing' का भूतकाल)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: "A person who is unable to read and write" is: [SSC Selection Post (10th) 19/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Illiterate is the definition for a person unable to read or write.
Other options:
- Innocent: Free from moral wrong or guilt.
- Ignorant: Lacking knowledge or awareness.
- Idle: Inactive or not working.
Vocab Meanings:
• Illiterate: Unable to read or write (निरक्षर / अनपढ़)
• Innocent: Not guilty; harmless (निर्दोष / मासूम)
• Ignorant: Lacking knowledge (अज्ञानी)
• Idle: Lazy; not working (आलसी / निष्क्रिय)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: A person who has broken the law and is a fugitive. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 21/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
An Outlaw is a person who has broken the law, especially someone who has fled or remains at large.
Other options:
'Sybarite' refers to a person devoted to luxury and pleasure.
'Menicure' (Manicure) is a cosmetic treatment of the hands and fingernails.
'Veteran' refers to a person who has had long experience in a particular field or service.
Vocab Meanings:
• Outlaw: A person who has broken the law and is running away (कानून तोड़ने वाला भगोड़ा / डाकू)
• Sybarite: A person who loves luxury and pleasure (विलासी व्यक्ति)
• Manicure: Cosmetic care of hands and nails (हाथों और नाखूनों की देखभाल)
• Veteran: A person with long experience; an ex-soldier (अनुभवी / पूर्व सैनिक)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: "A person who cannot hear" is: [SSC Selection Post (10th) 21/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
A person who cannot hear is termed Deaf.
Other options:
'Blind' means unable to see.
'Dumb' traditionally means unable to speak.
'Lame' means unable to walk normally due to an injury or illness.
Vocab Meanings:
• Deaf: Unable to hear (बहरा / बधिर)
• Blind: Unable to see (अंधा)
• Dumb: Unable to speak (गूँगा)
• Lame: Unable to walk properly (लंगड़ा)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: Behavior showing high moral standards. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 21/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Virtue denotes behavior showing high moral standards or goodness.
Other options:
'Pledge' is a solemn promise or undertaking.
'Plague' is a contagious disease or a pestilence.
'Solemn' is an adjective meaning formal, dignified, or serious.
Vocab Meanings:
• Virtue: High moral goodness (सद्गुण / नैतिकता)
• Pledge: A solemn promise (प्रतिज्ञा / वचन)
• Plague: A deadly infectious disease (महामारी / प्लेग)
• Solemn: Serious and formal (गंभीर / संजीदा)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: A person new to a field or activity. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 22/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
A Novice is a person who is new to and inexperienced in a job, field, or activity.
Other options:
'Rubbish' refers to waste material or nonsense.
'Peevish' means easily irritated or bad-tempered.
'Devilish' means like a devil; mischievous or cruel.
Vocab Meanings:
• Novice: A beginner in a field or activity (नौसिखिया)
• Rubbish: Waste material; nonsense (कूड़ा / बकवास)
• Peevish: Easily irritated (चिड़चिड़ा)
• Devilish: Wicked or mischievous (शैतानी)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: The quality of having experience and knowledge. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 22/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Wisdom is the quality of having experience, knowledge, and good judgment.
Other options:
'Heinus' (heinous) means utterly odious or wicked.
'Pedigree' refers to an ancestral line or genealogical history.
'Dukedom' refers to the territory or rank of a duke.
Vocab Meanings:
• Wisdom: Knowledge and good judgement from experience (बुद्धिमत्ता / ज्ञान)
• Heinous: Extremely wicked; shocking (जघन्य / घृणित)
• Pedigree: Record of ancestry (वंशावली)
• Dukedom: The rank or territory of a duke (ड्यूक की पदवी / रियासत)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: A system of segregation on grounds of race. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 22/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Apartheid was a policy or system of segregation or discrimination on grounds of race.
Other options:
'Exhaust' means to tire out or deplete completely.
'Custom' refers to a traditional practice or habit.
'Plunge' means to jump, dive, or fall quickly.
Vocab Meanings:
• Apartheid: A system of racial segregation (रंगभेद / नस्लीय पृथक्करण)
• Exhaust: To tire out or use up completely (थका देना / समाप्त करना)
• Custom: A traditional practice (रीति-रिवाज)
• Plunge: To jump or fall suddenly (डुबकी लगाना / गिरना)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: A child whose parents are dead. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 23/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
A child whose parents are dead is called an Orphan.
Other options:
Vulcan refers to the Roman god of fire; Tycoon is a wealthy, powerful business person; Denigrade is a misspelling of denigrate (to criticize unfairly).
Vocab Meanings:
• Orphan: A child whose parents are dead (अनाथ)
• Vulcan: The Roman god of fire (अग्नि देवता - रोमन)
• Tycoon: A very rich and powerful businessperson (धनकुबेर / बड़ा उद्योगपति)
• Denigrate: To criticise unfairly; to belittle (बदनाम करना / निंदा करना)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: A tropical storm in the Indian or Pacific oceans. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 23/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
A tropical storm in the region of the Indian or western Pacific oceans is called a Typhoon.
Other options:
Cliff is a steep rock face; Crest is the top or highest point of something; Crook is a bent or curved implement, or an informal term for a dishonest person.
Vocab Meanings:
• Typhoon: A tropical storm in the Indian or Pacific Ocean (समुद्री तूफ़ान / टाइफून)
• Cliff: A steep rock face (चट्टान / खड़ी ढलान)
• Crest: The top of a hill or wave (शिखर / कलगी)
• Crook: A dishonest person (धोखेबाज़ / बदमाश)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: A storm with a violent wind. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 24/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Definition: A hurricane is a severe tropical cyclone or storm with violent winds and heavy rain.
Other options:
• Acne: A common skin condition that causes pimples.
• Dart: A small pointed missile or a rapid movement.
• Defy: To openly resist or refuse to obey.
Vocab Meanings:
• Hurricane: A storm with violent wind (प्रचंड तूफ़ान / चक्रवात)
• Acne: Pimples on the skin (मुहाँसे)
• Dart: A small pointed missile; to move suddenly (तीर / तेज़ी से दौड़ना)
• Defy: To openly refuse to obey (अवज्ञा करना / ललकारना)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: A person who talks a great deal. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 24/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Definition: A chatterbox is an informal term for a person who talks excessively or incessantly.
Other options:
• Tuck: To push or fold the edges of something into a confined space.
• Array: An impressive display or range of a particular type of thing.
• Skim: To read or glance through quickly.
Vocab Meanings:
• Chatterbox: A person who talks a lot (बातूनी / वाचाल)
• Tuck: To push the edge of something into place (खोंसना / समेटना)
• Array: An ordered arrangement or range (श्रृंखला / व्यूह)
• Skim: To read quickly; to glide over (सरसरी नज़र डालना)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: A person or animal that lives in a specific place. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 24/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Definition: An inhabitant is a person or animal that lives in or occupies a particular place.
Other options:
• Beast: An animal, especially a large or dangerous four-footed one.
• Vigil: A period of keeping awake during the time usually spent asleep, especially to keep watch or pray.
• Drape: To arrange loosely or casually on or around something.
Vocab Meanings:
• Inhabitant: A person or animal living in a place (निवासी)
• Beast: A large wild animal (पशु / जानवर)
• Vigil: A period of staying awake to watch or pray (रात्रि जागरण / चौकसी)
• Drape: To cover loosely with cloth (परदा / ढकना)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: A very strong wind. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 25/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Gale refers to a very strong wind.
Other options:
• Tale: A fictitious or true narrative or story.
• Gel: A jelly-like substance.
• Male: Relating to the sex that produces gametes which can fertilize female eggs.
Vocab Meanings:
• Gale: A very strong wind (आँधी / तेज़ हवा)
• Tale: A story (कहानी)
• Gel: A jelly-like substance (जेल / गाढ़ा पदार्थ)
• Male: A man or boy (पुरुष / नर)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: To move or climb upward. [SSC Selection Post (10th) 25/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
Ascend means to go up, climb, or rise through the air.
Other options:
• Desccent (Descent): An action of moving downwards.
• Portentous: Done in a pompously solemn manner or acting as a sign of something momentous.
• Aviary: A large cage or enclosure for keeping birds.
Vocab Meanings:
• Ascend: To go or climb upward (ऊपर चढ़ना / आरोहण करना)
• Descent: The act of moving downward (अवरोहण / नीचे उतरना)
• Portentous: Warning of something bad; pompous (अशुभ सूचक / आडंबरपूर्ण)
• Aviary: A large cage for birds (पक्षीशाला)

question.en: From the given alternatives, select the one-word substitution of the following: "A person who writes poems" is: [SSC Selection Post (10th) 25/09/26 Shift 3]

solution.en:
A poet is a person who writes poetry or poems.
Other options:
• Author: A writer of a book, article, or document.
• Novelist: A person who writes novels.
• Editor: A person who is in charge of and determines the final content of a text or publication.
Vocab Meanings:
• Poet: A person who writes poems (कवि)
• Author: A writer of a book or article (लेखक)
• Novelist: A writer of novels (उपन्यासकार)
• Editor: A person who prepares content for publishing (संपादक)
